bias.en: Bearish · holding the $145.6 pivot on the close
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收盘守住 $145.6 转折点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS slipped 1.0% on Oct 15 to $146.11 on heavy volume after an intraday low of $137.80; with 69 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its 5-day ($156.4), 10-day ($170.3) and 30-day ($180.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($186.9), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月15日盘中一度跌至 $137.80，收盘放量下跌 1.0%，报 $146.11；上市仅 69 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于 5 日（$156.4）、10 日（$170.3）和 30 日均线（$180.0）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$186.9），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The day's low undercut the $145.6 Jul 17 pivot, but the close recovered above it. Resistance is $151.5–152.4 (Aug 24 pivot, Oct 14 high), then $156.4 (5-day average) and $170 (10-day). Support is $145.6, then $137.8 (Oct 15 low) and $133.8 (Aug 7 low). A close below $137.8 would open $133.8. Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: 当日低点跌破 $145.6 的 7月17日转折点，但收盘重新站上。阻力为 $151.5–152.4（8月24日转折点、10月14日高点），其次 $156.4（5 日均线）和 $170（10 日均线）。支撑为 $145.6，其次 $137.8（10月15日低点）和 $133.8（8月7日低点）。若收盘跌破 $137.8，下一目标看 $133.8。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

bias.zh: 偏空 · 测试 7 月低点

read.en: SK hynix fell 11.1% in Seoul on Oct 15 to ₩1,262,000 from ₩1,419,000, trading between ₩1,238,000 and ₩1,332,000. It is below its falling 5-day (₩1,398,200), 10-day (₩1,584,200) and 30-day (₩1,703,833) averages, the 100-day (₩1,915,250) and the rising 200-day (₩1,456,770). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 29 (₩1,700,480), and RSI is 25.

The ₩1,402,000 (Oct 14) and ₩1,373,000 (Aug 11) lows both broke, and the day's low of ₩1,238,000 dipped under the Jul 29 low (₩1,246,000) before the close held above it. Resistance is ₩1,332,000 (Oct 15 high), then ₩1.37–1.40 million (broken lows, 5-day average) and ₩1,456,770 (200-day). Below ₩1,238,000 are ₩1.2 million and the ₩1,060,000 March high. A close below ₩1,238,000 would open ₩1.2 million.

r.en: Oct 14 low ₩1,402,000 and 5-day average; Aug 11 low ₩1,373,000
